lines.lyric_hangul: 더 이상은 듣기 싫은 차가운 목소리 귀를 막아도
lines.lyric_translation: Don’t hear the cold voices anymore / I’m covering my ears

lines.lyric_hangul: 아무런 소용없이 따가운 시선들이 내 앞을 가로막죠
lines.lyric_translation: But it’s no use, the piercing looks / Block my way

lines.lyric_hangul: 다 때려 부숴 날 어둠에 가두고 괴롭히던 것들의 출처
lines.lyric_translation: I’m breaking it all down / All the sources of things / That trapped me in darkness and tortured me

lines.lyric_hangul: 벗어나려 애쓰지만 출구를 찾기 전까지는 답이 없어
lines.lyric_translation: I try to escape but there’s no answer / Till I find the exit

lines.lyric_hangul: 날 위하는 척 내 꿈을 무시하는 목소리들
lines.lyric_translation: Voices that act like they’re for me but really / They ignore my dreams

lines.lyric_hangul: 이젠 상처받기 싫어서 두 귀를 막고 내 길을 걸어
lines.lyric_translation: I don’t wanna get hurt again / So I’m covering my ears and walking on my path

parts.lyric: Du gwireul makgo nae gireul georeo

lines.lyric_translation: Now they’ve been going around

lines.lyric_hangul: 내 머릿속에 돌아 나를 어지럽게 하네 Go away hey
lines.lyric_translation: It’s in my head, making me dizzy, go away hey

parts.lyric: Nae meorissoge dora nareul eojireobge hane

lines.lyric_translation: Voices that torture me
Make me shout out again
Step out of them voices

lines.lyric: Nae du gwireul makgo ttodashi wechilge
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 두 귀를 막고 또다시 외칠게
lines.lyric_translation: I’ll cover my ears and shout out again
Step out of them voices

lines.lyric: Break free from the voices in my head
lines.lyric_hangul: Break free from the voices in my head
lines.lyric_translation: Break free from the voices in my head
Lingering in my ears
Can’t hear my voices
I hear that sound
It all feels so frustrating

lines.lyric: Kkeutkkaji deullyeooneun geu sorie gwi maga nan
lines.lyric_hangul: 끝까지 들려오는 그 소리에 귀 막아 난
lines.lyric_translation: I hear it till the end and I’m covering my ears
Stop, all the sounds that judge me
It annoys me like noisy neighbors
I keep hearing these nagging sounds from some point

lines.lyric: Shikkeureo ijeneun I don’t wanna hear no more
lines.lyric_hangul: 시끄러 이제는 I don't wanna hear no more
lines.lyric_translation: It’s noisy, I don’t wanna hear no more

lines.lyric_hangul: 구제 불능 엉터리 난 네, 얘기에 절대 속지 않지 uh
lines.lyric_translation: I’m a mess, impossible to save / I won’t ever be deceived by those words

lines.lyric_hangul: 궁금하지도 않은 말 뻔뻔히 해봤자 하품만 연발해 번번이
lines.lyric_translation: I’m not even curious, it’s so obvious / It’ll just make me yawn each time

lines.lyric_hangul: 왜 그리 얘기만 해 speakers 톤 업 돼서 또 언성을 높여
lines.lyric_translation: Why do you keep talking, the speakers / Are turning up so your voice turns up too

parts.lyric: Ton eob dwaeseo tto eonseongeul nopyeo

lines.lyric_hangul: 이젠 신경 안 써 Don't care no more 됐어 날 내버려 둬
lines.lyric_translation: I don’t care anymore, don’t care no more / Just leave me alone

parts.lyric: Ijen shingyeong an sseo don’t care no more

lines.lyric_translation: Now they’ve been going around

lines.lyric_translation: It’s in my head, making me dizzy, go away hey

lines.lyric_translation: I’ll cover my ears and shout out again

lines.lyric_hangul: 끝까지 들려오는 그 소리에 귀 막아 난
lines.lyric_translation: I hear it till the end and I’m covering my ears

lines.lyric_hangul: No more No more 나를 바꿔 놓으려 하지 마
lines.lyric_translation: No more, no more / Don’t try to change me

lines.lyric_hangul: No voice No voice 날 더는 어지럽게 하지 마
lines.lyric_translation: No voice, no voice / Stop making me so dizzy

lines.lyric: Ya jabsaenggageun da jibeochiwo da ne meottaero hae
lines.lyric_hangul: 야 잡생각은 다 집어치워 다 네 멋대로 해
lines.lyric_translation: Put away all other thoughts, do whatever you want

lines.lyric_hangul: 야 속지마 너도 아닌 건 알잖아 제발 네 멋대로 해
lines.lyric_translation: Don’t be deceived, you know that’s not true / Please just do whatever you want

parts.lyric: Ya sokjima neodo anin geon aljana

lines.lyric_translation: Just stop it now, please
I wanna think simple thoughts
No need to care about everything
There’s so many voices
Step out of them voices
Step out of them voices
There’s so many voices
